name: Phases 5 & 6 - Advanced Intelligence & Postgreyskull Integration
description: Transition to ZenAdapter, refined orchestration, and PostgreSQL + pgvector + Apache AGE hybrid memory.

userStories.title: Implement ZenAdapter Multi-Protocol Gateway
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a single adapter that routes requests to different providers using the OpenCode Zen protocol.
acceptanceCriteria: Create ZenAdapter in src/donkey/adapters/provider/zen.nim
Implement mapping for opencode/<model-id> to respective provider endpoints
Support completion and streaming via Zen protocol
Satisfy ProviderPort concept
nimble test passes

userStories.title: Refine Multi-Agent Coordination Logic
userStories.description: As a user, I want the Orchestrator to coordinate more effectively with Tool and Memory agents.
acceptanceCriteria: Optimize OrchestratorAgent message loops in src/donkey/app/orchestrator.nim
Implement parallel worker spawning/cleanup based on session lifecycle
Add explicit amkCancel propagation to all sub-agents
bash scripts/run_tests.sh passes
bash scripts/check_boundaries.sh passes

userStories.title: Token Tracking and Advanced Failover
userStories.description: As an operator, I want to track token usage per session and have the system automatically failover.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement token usage recording in src/donkey/domain/usage_tracking.nim
Enhance failover.nim to trigger based on status codes/latency
Expose usage stats via the /status command
nimble test passes

userStories.title: Postgreyskull - Schema and Vector Integration
userStories.description: As a system, I need a PostgreSQL schema with pgvector support to store and retrieve embeddings.
acceptanceCriteria: Create SQL migration scripts for donkey_memories table
Implement PostgresMemoryAdapter with pgvector support (4096 dimensions)
Implement vector insertion and similarity search in postgres_memory.nim
Verify with real PostgreSQL instance in Docker
nimble test passes

userStories.title: Hybrid Memory Sync (DB <-> Markdown)
userStories.description: As a user, I want my Markdown paddock files to stay in sync with the PostgreSQL database.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement ingestion mechanism from .md files to DB
Implement export mechanism from DB to .md files (Markdown View)
Ensure MdFileAdapter acts as fallback
nimble test passes

userStories.title: Hybrid Semantic Search (Vector + Cypher)
userStories.description: As an agent, I want to perform hybrid searches combining vector similarity with AGE graph traversal.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement Apache AGE graph schema (Nodes: Person, Fact, Memory; Edges: KNOWS, MENTIONS)
Create search function combining pgvector hits with Cypher results
Integrate hybrid search into RAG context hook
Verify with real PostgreSQL/AGE instance in Docker
nimble test passes
